# muxt fmt formats a template with the package that embeds it, which
# may be in a parent directory: templates/ holds no Go files, and m.go
# embeds templates/*.gohtml. The <style> in layout.gohtml, another
# template of that package, makes .x preserve whitespace, and the
# package's author CSS is known, so the classed section is reindented
# while the .x interior is kept as written.

! muxt fmt -l templates/page.gohtml
cmp stdout want-list.txt
muxt fmt templates/page.gohtml
stdout '(?m)^\t<p>a</p>$'
stdout '\n  keep   me\n</div>\n'

# The same from inside the subdirectory.

! muxt fmt -C templates -l page.gohtml
cmp stdout want-list-c.txt
muxt fmt -C templates page.gohtml
stdout '(?m)^\t<p>a</p>$'
stdout '\n  keep   me\n</div>\n'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- m.go --
package m

import "embed"

//go:embed templates/*.gohtml
var templates embed.FS
-- templates/layout.gohtml --
{{define "head"}}<style>.x{white-space:pre}</style>{{end}}
-- templates/page.gohtml --
<section class="y">
<div class="x">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>a</p>
</section>
-- want-list.txt --
templates/page.gohtml
-- want-list-c.txt --
page.gohtml
